title: Expose AppService location and EUDB membership on Environment Information for internal consumption
summary: Environment Information now exposes App Service location and EU Data Boundary membership status for internal use, restricted to Microsoft-published callers and returning defaults outside SaaS.
key_points: Two new procedures added to expose AppService location and EUDB membership
Both procedures restricted to Microsoft-published callers only
Returns empty location and false EUDB status when outside SaaS infrastructure
Includes partner and standard test coverage for the new functionality
IsApplicationServiceInEUDB() returns false when outside EUDB or information unavailable
